definitions.explanation: The twentieth day of any month.

examples.japanese: {二十日|はつか}⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
{二十日|はつか}⟦ぐらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
{二十日|はつか}⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二十日|はつか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{終|お}わる→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The construction is scheduled to be completed in twenty days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二十日|はつか}⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{足|た}りる→足りる：01209_tariru⟧⟦はず→はず：01557_hazu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I received twenty days' worth of medicine, so it should last until next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一月|いちがつ}→一月：00631_ichigatsu⟧{二十日|はつか}
{二十日|はつか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}きます→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
{二十日|はつか}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お→お：03097_o⟧⟦{届|とど}けします→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧。
examples.english: We will deliver it by the 20th.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{二十日|はつか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a meeting on the 20th of next month.

examples.japanese: {二十日|はつか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{祝日|しゅくじつ}→祝日：07588_shukujitsu⟧⟦なので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The 20th is a holiday, so both school and work are off.

notes:
{二十日|はつか} has two uses: "twenty days" (a duration) and "the 20th" (a date). The reading はつか is irregular and must be memorized.

SPECIAL DAY READINGS (1st-10th):
Days 1-10 of the month all have unique native Japanese readings: ⟦{一日|ついたち}→一日：10993_tsuitachi⟧, ⟦{二日|ふつか}→二日：02954_futsuka⟧, ⟦{三日|みっか}→三日：02969_mikka⟧, ⟦{四日|よっか}→四日：02985_yokka⟧, ⟦{五日|いつか}→五日：28460_itsuka⟧, ⟦{六日|むいか}→六日：02973_muika⟧, ⟦{七日|なのか}→七日：02927_nanoka⟧, ⟦{八日|ようか}→八日：02983_youka⟧, ⟦{九日|ここのか}→九日：02901_kokonoka⟧, ⟦{十日|とおか}→十日：02917_tooka⟧.

AFTER THE 10TH:
Most days use Sino-Japanese numbers + {日|にち} (e.g., ⟦{十一日|じゅういちにち}→十一日：30352_juuichinichi⟧), but a few retain special readings:
- ⟦{十四日|じゅうよっか}→十四日：30216_juuyokka⟧ (14th)
- {二十日|はつか} (20th)
- ⟦{二十四日|にじゅうよっか}→二十四日：30217_nijuuyokka⟧ (24th)

COMMON COMPOUND:
- {二十日|はつか}⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧: small Japanese radish (literally "20-day radish" because it matures quickly)
